desc: Implement the baseline monotone 3D best-first heap solution with descending sorted arrays, truncation to L = min(N, K), encoded triples, visited set, and K heap pops.
Validate against all provided public samples (passed all 3).
Verify correctness arguments: monotonicity, truncation, best-first frontier property, encoding/tie-breaking, and edge cases.
Confirm complexity O(N log N + K log K) and memory O(K) is within constraints (K <= 5e5).
